about: The module that implements each engine's part, by engine, kept apart from engine_knobs.json so a reader of the knob rows does not load the adapters. adapter: the module workflow/tune.py loads (tune.table merges it into engines.<E>) to read that engine's build, supply its facts, run its measured points and write its command. mtp: the module collectors/mtp.py loads to measure the engine's multi-token prediction. out_of_memory: the engine's own words when a GPU allocation fails, a regular expression over its log, read only where no structured signal says why a process failed (its exit status says that it failed, not why): load-probe's out-of-memory label and the llama-server driver's reason. fit_words: llama.cpp's own words for its -fit outcome (common/fit.cpp), which it says only in its log, read by the llama-server driver's fit probe. version_words: vLLM's build in a retained log, for evidence recorded before replay read its /version. Each is tested against the pinned engine's source (tests/test_load_probe.py).

graph_stats.why: the graph-cap mod's stats line (GGML_CUDA_GRAPH_STATS=1, arkey_ie_mods llama.cpp/graph-cap): one per graph executable built, with its backend context, its graph and its chunk; a context's chunks a graph = the highest chunk + 1 = ceil(nodes of its largest CUDA split graph / the chunk size)

llama.cpp.out_of_memory: \b[A-Za-z]+ error: (out of memory|the resource allocation failed)|cudaMalloc failed|failed to allocate (?!CPU)[A-Za-z]+\d* buffer|ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory|hipErrorOutOfMemory

fit_words.failed: failed to fit params to free device memory
fit_words.error: encountered an error while trying to fit params to free device memory
fit_words.by_context: entire model can be fit by reducing context

vllm.out_of_memory: torch\.OutOfMemoryError|CUDA out of memory|CUDA error: out of memory
